name: flowstudio-power-automate
description: Debug, build, manage, and govern Power Automate cloud flows via FlowStudio MCP. Nine skills for flow diagnostics, deployment, tenant-wide monitoring, compliance metadata, and canvas app reading, editing, and shipping (canvas tools are in preview).

interface.shortDescription: Debug, build, manage, and govern Power Automate flows with AI agents
interface.longDescription: Give your AI agent the same visibility you have in the Power Automate portal — plus tenant-wide governance and monitoring. The Graph API only returns top-level run status. FlowStudio MCP exposes action-level inputs, outputs, loop iterations, and nested child flow failures. Nine bundled skills: power-automate-mcp (operations), power-automate-debug (diagnostics), power-automate-build (deployment), power-automate-monitoring (Pro+ tenant health), power-automate-governance (Pro+ compliance metadata), and four Power Apps canvas app skills (preview): power-apps-canvas-mcp (ground rules), power-apps-canvas-read (inspect), power-apps-canvas-edit (build and change), power-apps-canvas-ship (push and publish).
capabilities: Power Automate flow operations and debugging
Action-level inputs, outputs, and loop iteration inspection
Flow definition build and deployment from natural language
Power Apps canvas app reading, editing, and publishing (preview)
defaultPrompt: Build a new flow that sends form data via email
Show me the top failing flows in my tenant this week
Add a gallery of my SharePoint list to this canvas app
